originality.rationale: Tsuchiya (2015) already describes the same asymmetric antichain/chain polytope and all of its facet normals, so those are credited. Ohsugi–Tsuchiya (2019) studies Ehrhart and gamma-positivity, not all maximal Euclidean ball centers or contact strata. Closest published-finding corpus symmetric twinned-chain theorem explicitly covers only identical posets; it does not logically cover the asymmetric mixed pair. Actual targeted queries and primary-full-text inspections found no direct equivalent; historical-priority uncertainty remains.
residual_risks: An unindexed exact Chebyshev-center analysis under a different polytope name may already imply the same endpoints.
The preexisting general facet classification simplifies the derivation; historical originality of the specific metric conclusions remains subject to independent literature audit.
